response.text: I have a few anomalies to check: the unbalanced journal, the negative invoice, and whether the journal-to-invoice link and payment journals hold up. I'll run one more targeted query.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'unbalanced' k, "JRNL_NO"::text a, (SUM("DR_AMT")-SUM("CR_AMT"))::text b FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING ROUND(SUM("DR_AMT")-SUM("CR_AMT"),2)<>0 UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_inv', "INV_ID"::text, "INV_AMT"::text||' '||"STAT_CD" FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_vs_inv_mismatch', p."INV_ID"::text, (SUM(p."PAY_AMT"))::text||' vs '||MAX(i."INV_AMT")::text FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" GROUP BY p."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT" HAVING ROUND(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),2)<>ROUND(MAX(i."INV_AMT"),2) UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_period_mismatch', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text||' post '||h."POST_DT"::text FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" LIMIT 20;
